current_date: August 2026 (link title 'Validation August 2026' on the council's Planning validation downloads page; the document text itself states no adoption or publication date)
current_evidence: The council's 'Planning validation' downloads page (southribble.gov.uk/downloads/download/113/planning-validation) lists 'Validation August 2026' as the only validation document, alongside Appendix 5, Appendix 6, heritage statement guidance and a BNG self-build proforma.

issues.detail: The 2026-08-01 date comes only from the URL and link title. The document has no dated cover, header or adoption statement, and still carries stale wording ('From November 2025 (exact date tbc)' for BNG on NSIPs). The date should be marked as taken from the link title rather than from the text.
issues.evidence: Download page shows only 'Validation August 2026'; no 'adopted', 'published' or 'updated' text found in the document

issues.detail:
Most tab_items are form boilerplate from the North West SuDS pro-forma (Appendix 5), not validation requirements:
- five near-identical 'Please list any relevant document and or drawing numbers ... to support your answers to Section 1-5' lines
- 'State the hydraulic method used...'
- 'be supplied as an Excel spreadsheet...'
- 'if you do not submit a completed pro-forma your application will not be processed...'
The last item ('Please note, no burning is permitted on site. 50 Local Requirements for Designated Sites...') joins Construction Management Plan guidance to a page number and an appendix heading.
issues.evidence: Tab items 4-11

issues.detail:
Householder is marked '(none)', but Section 8 is a Householder checklist with local items:
- parking provision if 'Yes' to Q8
- tree survey or arboricultural implications if 'Yes' to Q7
- Planning Statement
- Daylight/Sunlight assessment
- Heritage Statement if within a Conservation Area
- site plan at 1:100/1:200, sections and levels, and roof plans
Parking and Access Details also states that householder applications must show existing and proposed off-street parking.
issues.evidence: Section 8: 'Parking Provision if 'Yes' to Question 8 of application form'; 'Tree survey/Arboricultural implications if 'Yes' to Question 7'; 'Heritage Statement (if within a Conservation Area)'

issues.detail: Affordable Housing Statement is not captured. It applies to residential developments of 15 or more dwellings in urban areas (30% affordable), 10 or more in rural areas (35%), and 100% on rural exception or Green Belt sites.
issues.evidence: 'For residential developments of 15 dwellings or more in urban areas where a 30% affordable provision is required'

issues.detail: Contaminated Land Assessment is not captured. It applies where the proposed use is particularly sensitive to contamination (housing, schools, health, play areas) or the site is within 250 m of a former landfill.
issues.evidence: 'Where the proposed development is particularly sensitive to land contamination.'

issues.detail: Lifetime Homes Statement is not captured. It applies to all new residential development, both new build and conversion.
issues.evidence: 'For new residential development, both new build and conversion.'

issues.detail:
Several other list items are not captured:
- Public Rights of Way Statement: development affecting a public right of way or its setting
- Renewable Energy Statement: renewable or low-carbon schemes such as solar, wind, heat pumps and biomass
- Agricultural Buildings Statement: all new agricultural buildings, with the Appendix 7 ADAS form
issues.evidence: Local Planning Validation section, items 'Public Rights of Way Statement', 'Renewable Energy Statement', 'Agricultural Buildings Statement'

issues.detail:
Two employment items are not captured:
- Employment Assessment: development on current or last-used employment sites, with residential schemes also needing marketing and notification evidence
- Regeneration and Economic Statement: new employment uses, loss of employment land, or partial redevelopment of employment sites
Grokbot's single 'Employment / Economic Statement' row quotes noise text instead.
issues.evidence: Local list items 'Employment Assessment' and 'Regeneration and Economic Statement'

issues.detail:
Several lesser items are not captured:
- Fee Calculation Summary: major and complicated applications
- Supporting Statement: developments that do not need a Design and Access Statement
- Sequential Assessment: a separate item from Retail Impact Assessment, for main town centre uses outside centres
- Access Details: new or altered highway access
- Utilities Statement: major development connecting to existing utilities
- Protected Species Assessment and Survey: a separate item from the Ecological/Geological Assessment
issues.evidence: Local Planning Validation section item headings
issues.grok_comment: Fee Calculation Summary, Utilities Statement and Sequential Assessment are not separately captured, but Access Details is in the workbook as "Highways / access details (visibility splays)" (text "public highway, visibility splays...") and protected species are covered by the "Ecological Survey (incl. PEA, protected species)" row.
issues.claude_response: Partly accepted. Access details and protected species are captured. Fee summary, utilities and sequential assessment are still missing.

issues.detail: 'Drainage Strategy / SuDS' and 'Energy / Sustainability Statement' are placed only under Outline, apparently because the word 'outline' appears nearby. The SuDS Strategy and pro-forma are required for 'any application for major development', and the Sustainability Statement for 'All residential development and all major non-residential development', so both belong under Full planning too.
issues.evidence: 'A SuDS Strategy and SuDS Pro-forma are both a requirement for any application for major development.'

issues.detail: 'Structural Survey' is placed under Listed building consent with the Lighting Assessment's trigger text. Structural Survey actually applies to conversions of barns, stables, piggeries, outhouses and garages to residential use. Separately, the 'Lighting Assessment' row under Full planning quotes Construction Management Plan text about lighting during construction instead of its own trigger. Its real trigger covers new external lighting, publicly accessible developments, sites near homes, listed buildings or conservation areas, and open countryside where wildlife such as bats may be affected.
issues.evidence: 'For applications for building conversion to residential such as barn, stable, piggery, outhouse, garage'; Lighting: 'Where external lighting would be provided or made necessary by the development;'

issues.detail: 'Lawful development evidence (statutory declarations etc.)' is placed under Full planning, while Lawful development cert is marked '(none)'. The list's Lawful Development Certificate item covers these evidence requirements (sworn statements and so on), so the row belongs under Lawful development cert.
issues.evidence: 'statements from owners or applicants which give crucial evidence should always be sworn in the proper form'

issues.detail:
Three other placements are wrong:
- Reserved matters is '(none)', but the Construction Management Plan applies to 'Full and Reserved Matters Major applications within residential areas'.
- Listed building consent lacks the Heritage Statement ('For all works affecting a Listed Building or structure').
- Telecommunications Supplementary Information is filed under Full planning, but it applies to mast and antenna applications by mobile operators.
issues.evidence: Construction Management Plan, Heritage Statement and Telecommunications triggers in the local list

issues.detail:
Two triggers are unrelated text:
- Construction (Environmental) Management Plan quotes a table-of-contents line ('...Construction Management Plan condition.....48 Appendix 2...'). The real trigger is Full and Reserved Matters major applications within residential areas.
- Statement of Community Involvement quotes tree-protection text ('showing trees for retention...'). The real trigger is major applications, those with wider implications, and community facilities.
issues.evidence: Community Involvement Statement: 'Major applications, those with wider implications, community facilities.'

issues.detail:
Three triggers are mixed up:
- Employment / Economic Statement quotes noise text and an Environmental Health phone number. The real Employment and Skills Statement trigger is residential over 30 units or commercial over 1,000 sqm.
- Ventilation / Extraction quotes the Secured by Design trigger. The real trigger is change of use to A3-A5 and significant developments with ventilation or extraction.
- Crime prevention / Secured by Design runs into Noise/Odour headings.
issues.evidence: 'For all applications for residential development over 30 units.'

issues.detail: The 'Arboricultural Impact Assessment / Tree Survey' trigger is garbled ('Regulations 2012, Arboricultural Association ... species numbers are likely to change...'). The real trigger is trees within the application site, trees on adjacent land within 15 m of the boundary, or street trees between the site and the highway.
issues.evidence: 'Where there are trees within the application site, trees on adjacent land within 15 metres of the boundary'

issues.detail:
Three more triggers are fragments or quote the wrong section:
- Planning Obligations is a fragment ('scale of planning obligations and other costs.'). The real trigger is 10 or more dwellings for open space, and major schemes of 10 or more dwellings for affordable housing.
- Heritage Statement quotes Design and Access Statement content for listed building consent, cut off at '6.'.
- Photographs / Photomontages quotes telecoms Supporting Statement text. The real trigger is major, demolition, infill, and conservation area or listed building schemes.
issues.evidence: Planning Obligations / Draft Heads of Terms and Photographs and Photomontages items

issues.detail:
Several excerpts describe what to include rather than when the item is required:
- Air Quality omits the AQMA, traffic, HGV and parking thresholds.
- Noise omits the uses near homes, roads, railways and industry.
- Ecological quotes the EPS licence sentence.
- BNG cites the NSIP 'November 2025 (exact date tbc)' note instead of 'Mandatory for Major and Minor Development'.
- Flood Risk Assessment gives only Flood Zones 2 and 3 and omits Flood Zone 1 sites of 1 ha or more.
issues.evidence: BNG: 'Mandatory for Major and Minor Development.'

issues.detail:
Three rows are duplicates or not list items:
- 'Sunlight to gardens/amenity space' repeats the Daylight/Sunlight Assessment text.
- 'Biodiversity Checklist / Questionnaire' is a fragment ('within the biodiversity statement and/or gain plan.') with no matching item in the list.
- 'Habitats Regulations Assessment information' repeats the Ecological/Geological Assessment trigger.
issues.evidence: Identical or near-identical trigger_excerpt text across these rows

issues.detail: About 35 rows are tagged 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning', so almost everything sits under Full planning. Outline gets only 2 items and Reserved matters none, even though most items apply to all applications meeting the trigger. Examples include Air Quality, Flood Risk Assessment, Transport Assessment and Viability.
issues.evidence: app_type_rows notes column

summary: Grokbot's link is the current South Ribble list ('Validation August 2026' on the council's download page), but the extraction is poor. The tab items are mostly SuDS pro-forma boilerplate, the Householder checklist and items such as Affordable Housing, Contaminated Land and Lifetime Homes are missing, and many triggers are garbled or swapped between requirements.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
